archetypes.name: timing-surface
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the timing-pin scanner plan actually covers every implement timing emitter and vendor recorder in the scoped repo evidence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the A1/A2 scanner and pinning plan against the actual timing-ledger.sh mark, timing-ledger.sh record-vendor-task, and timing-report.sh call surfaces in the listed scripts. Look for omitted production emitters, overbroad grep/awk matching, same-line assumptions that fail on continuations, and accidental inclusion of review-only launch paths that should not be pinned to implement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: monitor-outcomes
archetypes.rationale: Validates that the proposed CI monitor tests match real monitor control flow rather than invented or unreachable outcomes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/test_ci_monitor.py and the underlying ci monitor implementation patterns that its tests exercise. Verify that the proposed already_merged and consecutive status-error scenarios are genuinely uncovered, reachable through monitor(), and compatible with existing RecordingRunner and parity-table conventions. Watch for plan language that leaves implementers guessing about exact Outcome values or duplicates existing evaluate_failure coverage. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: Hunts drift between comment-only/doc-only plan steps and the repository’s normative contracts for logs, quiet streams, and design-outline scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether every proposed prose or comment change has the right sibling contract files and whether the no-op C verification scope is sufficient to close the stale design-outline issue. Compare scripts/larch-log.sh with scripts/larch-log.md, python/logging_util.py with python/README.md and scripts/lib-quiet.md, and the design-outline references with plan-review-loop surfaces. Look for missing cross-doc updates, stale terminology, or plan claims that contradict canonical docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: log-publication
archetypes.rationale: Reviews whether the log-retention and SECURITY.md plan accurately reflects artifact inclusion rules and redaction residual risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the D1/D2/D4 plan against scripts/larch-log.sh artifact allow/deny logic, the write-round harness, and SECURITY.md’s documented redaction posture. Look for sidecar fixture names that would not hit the intended static deny clause, comments that still overclaim independence from broad globs, and security prose that understates pattern-based scrubber residual risk. Confirm the plan does not accidentally propose behavior changes where it says comment/docs only. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
